messages:
Maria CSM: Morning — Voyager private VPC weekly onboarding pulse. TL;DR: usage growth +18% WoW, overall spend creeping up (see below), two operational hotspots: EU-WEST KMS timeouts causing 5–10s crypto retries for a subset of requests, and AP-SE cold-cache spikes on model startup. Asking infra/support for short term mitigations and a plan for key rotation window.

Alex Infra: Noted. I pulled infra logs — looks like the KMS timeouts line up with a renewed cert handshake/backoff pattern from their edge fleet. I can add circuit-breaker rules to reduce downstream retries.

Sam Eng: Can you paste the metric snapshot? I'll check kernel/quantization warm paths; AP-SE cold starts might be model shard placement.

Maria CSM: Metric snapshot (current week):
```
US-EAST-1: p50 120ms, p95 420ms, errors 0.8%, est spend $2,300/wk
EU-WEST-1: p50 160ms, p95 510ms, errors 1.9% (KMS timeouts), est spend $1,100/wk
AP-SE-1: p50 200ms, p95 650ms, errors 2.4% (cold cache), est spend $900/wk
Usage: 18% increase in token consumption vs last week, peak concurrency up ~35%
```

Priya Support: Voyager reported 3 customer-facing errors yesterday during a European deploy. They saw `decrypt_timeout` in logs. I've opened an incident for tracking: INC-3571.

KMS-bot: Detected: key_rotate_event scheduled for key: voyager-prod-eu at 2024-11-14T03:00:00Z. Pending rotations: 1. Current rotation window overlaps planned customer deploys.

Alex Infra: If rotation is happening during their deploy window that would explain transient decrypt timeouts. Recommend: postpone rotation to maintenance window or enable rotation-with-backoff config. I'll draft a small retry-policy patch for their SDK (exponential backoff + jitter, cap 3).

Sam Eng: For AP-SE cold-cache, short-term fix: enable a small pre-warm traffic ramp (2–3 minutes) during their off-peak deploys to populate KV cache. Longer-term: consider moving a hot shard to AP-SE region to reduce remote fetches. I'll scope effort: ~2 dev days.

Maria CSM: Action items recap: 1) Alex — push retry/circuit-breaker patch and coordinate with Voyager SRE; ETA today EOD. 2) Priya — confirm rotation window change with KMS ops and Voyager PM; link update to INC-3571. 3) Sam — scope hot-shard move + short pre-warm plan; drop estimate by EOW. 4) Maria — schedule a 30m sync with Voyager and infra tomorrow.

Priya Support: Confirmed — I messaged Voyager PM, they prefer rotation after their next scheduled deploy on 2024-11-15. I'll update KMS ops and tag here once confirmed.

Alex Infra: Patch uploaded to staging, short test looks good. I'll roll to prod behind a feature flag and monitor decrypt success rate.

KMS-bot: Rotation window updated: voyager-prod-eu -> 2024-11-15T04:00:00Z (confirmed).

Maria CSM: Nice. One risk to call out for renewal: Voyager flagged cost sensitivity if spend growth continues >20% next month. We'll track spend delta and propose batching/quantization recommendations from Optimize if trend continues.

Sam Eng: Noted on cost flag. I'll add quantization suggestion set and estimated cost delta to the deck by Friday.

Maria CSM: Thanks all — please update INC-3571 with any deploy notes. I'll run the sync invite and include Voyager PM + SRE.

Alex Infra: +1. Ping if you want me on the call.

Priya Support: I'll stay on for the KMS handoff.

Maria CSM: End of thread — short check-in next Tuesday unless anything critical pops up. :thumbsup:
